function.name: request_human_escalation
function.description: Call this to alert a human team member. Use request_now=true for an emergency (e.g. gas smell) requiring immediate attention. Use request_now=false for a business-hours callback (e.g. caller explicitly asks for a human, or the request cannot be resolved through this conversation). Always include a callback phone number.

issue.description: Brief description of the issue prompting escalation

request_now.description: true for an immediate/emergency alert, false for a business-hours callback

phone_number.description: Callback number for the human team member to reach the caller
